title: Balanced Triples
statement:
`n` accounts each hold a balance, which may be negative. Count the triples of different positions `i < j < k` whose three balances add up to exactly zero. Equal values at different positions form different triples.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers, the balances.

## Output
Print the number of triples `i < j < k` with `a_i + a_j + a_k = 0`.

## Constraints
- `3 <= n <= 1000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
